dedupe_keys.name: aerodynamic dataset for selected doubly curved membrane canopy structures

description: Aerodynamic dataset for selected doubly curved membrane canopy structures is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Anoop Kodakkal et al. A dataset of aerodynamic measurements is collected for doubly curved membrane structures as part of an experimental testing campaign on wind effects on structural membranes conducted at the WindEEE Dome at Western University, Canada. Common doubly curved membrane geometries (the hypar, ridge valley, arch supported, cone, and umbrella) were tested in isolated instances. Coverage: national (CA); published in 2025. Formats: Excel, MATLAB, Image, Python. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
